dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as a single, thin, high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp, distinct pale gray boundaries along the edges of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, rectangular/oval-shaped white patch of high contrast on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear transition boundary separating the black crown from the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white patch on the auricular/cheek region surrounded by black plumage.
